page: Amazon Web Services c8gd.24xlarge is an ARM64 compute-optimized server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processor running at 2.8 GHz. It features 192.0 GB of memory, translating to a 2.0 GB per core ratio, and is built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks highlight exceptional multi-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier status in multi-core CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and software compilation. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, scoring in the top tier for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read/write operations. Single-core performance sits in the average range, indicating that workloads benefit most from parallel execution across its 96 physical cores.

The inclusion of 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage combined with high memory bandwidth makes this instance highly cost-efficient for data-dense, compute-heavy workloads. It excels in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving, all of which register top-tier benchmark results. Additionally, it demonstrates strong capabilities in multi-threaded tasks like ray tracing and medium-to-large LLM text generation.
